description: EUROCAE ED-269 geo-zone documents read strictly (U-03). accepted true: the zones as summarised (limits in metres) and, where given, the export, which must equal the input. accepted false: every problem with its JSON path and reason; a Go implementation must at least produce must_include (path suffix and reason phrase), and should report all problems, capped at 100 with a count of the rest. Field names follow InterUSS uas_standards eurocae_ed269.py, Luxembourg's live file and the Swiss BAZL profile, since EUROCAE's text is paywalled. WGS84 as a vertical reference is this project's extension.

tolerance.problems: path and phrase as in must_include
